FN-4T82RIR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 29
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2025
Senate Bill 29 as introduced would require state and local governmental bodies to respond to
completed applications for certain licenses within forty-five days of receiving completed
applications, which could increase the administrative obligations of state and local
governmental bodies to review applications pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-4T82RIR-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 29
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/11/2025
Senate Bill 29 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
require state and local governmental bodies to respond to completed applications for certain
licenses within forty-five days of receiving completed applications unless otherwise specified by
state or federal law, which could increase the administrative obligations of state and local
governmental bodies to review applications pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
